title: Synthwave
tagline: Retro-futurist electronic music built from synthesizers and cinematic nostalgia.
summary: Synthwave is an electronic style inspired by 1980s film scores, soundtracks, and synthesizer music. Producers use vintage-flavored synths, drum machines, and cinematic arrangements to create a nostalgic but contemporary sound. The genre's visual identity and online communities have helped it grow across music, games, and film.

pillars.name: Kavinsky
pillars.why: Kavinsky's cinematic electronic releases became a widely recognized reference for synthwave's retro-futurist sound.

pillars.name: College
pillars.why: College helped shape the style's nostalgic synth textures and connection to visual storytelling.

pillars.name: Perturbator
pillars.why: Perturbator developed a darker, heavier synthwave approach associated with the genre's cyberpunk edge.
